intelligence.enrichment: Adolescence is the period of change from childhood to adulthood. It generally begins around 10 years of age and usually lasts until 19 years, and the body gradually reaches maturity for reproduction during this period. human growth over time -> adolescence -> physical, emotional, behavioural, and reproductive changes The learner identifies adolescence as the human period between childhood and adulthood, generally around ages 10 to 19, during which growth and reproductive maturity develop. Adolescence just means getting taller around middle school age.
